name: zinterp_context_command_equals
description: zInterp_Context::CommandEquals compares tokenList[0] against a complete command string.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja cannot fully lift the VC inline strcmp sbb flag idiom at 0x4c54f8, but the assembly-visible behavior is an exact string equality test.
Original assembly compares through a null command pointer when tokenCount is zero; callers normally gate command dispatch before using this helper.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c54b0 validates reading tokenCount at context offset 0x08, selecting tokenList[0] at offset 0x20 when tokenCount is nonzero, running an inline strcmp-style byte loop against the requested command, and returning one only for an exact match.
The native smoke verifies exact match and nonmatch behavior against tokenList[0].
